messages.content:
Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

What is the last day on which a machine can be placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC so that Member States may not afterwards impede its making available on the market under the transitional provisions of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: Up to which final date can a machine be placed on the market in compliance with Directive 2006/42/EC so that, under the transitional provisions of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, Member States cannot subsequently obstruct its being made available on the market?
